summary: This plugin is a task orchestration companion for DeepSeek Harness that provides a local visual Kanban board and links task cards to Codex-driven execution through registered plugin tools.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily an AI workflow orchestration aid: it adds a local visual Kanban board to DeepSeek Harness and ties task cards to chat-driven execution via registered tools, with `kanban_codex` delegating bounded implementation work back to the same card context for review. Evidence from the README shows card state management, evidence tracking, and local durable storage as core behavior, while package metadata confirms it is a DSH plugin bundle with official Codex integration dependency.
